text: SIPROTEC 7UT86 is a modular differential protection relay for three-winding transformers that serves as main protection for critical assets.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7UT86?

text: Protect your transformers and connected grid assets from faults and operational disturbances. SIPROTEC 7UT86 provides robust differential protection and additional function to act as backup for objects like cables, lines and shunt reactors.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7UT86?

text: Adapt hardware to your needs with modular expandability. Configure all functions using the DIGSI 5 engineering tool for a custom setup.
